cases.scenario: A session issued after password entry but before required MFA can change an enrolled factor.
cases.expected_decision: Confirm if the protected change violates the documented proof requirement and persists.

cases.scenario: An owner-provisioned one-use recovery code correctly restores access and cannot be reused.
cases.expected_decision: Do not label the designed recovery as an MFA bypass.

cases.scenario: A response says MFA enabled, but actual enrollment and subsequent challenge behavior are unknown.
cases.expected_decision: Keep the factor-state claim unverified until durable/login behavior is observed.
